findings.summary: `manifest.json` is missing: add the file (see the minimal manifest)
not valid JSON, or the top level is not an object: fix the syntax at the position given
`manifest` is missing, not an integer, or not a version this product reads: use `"manifest": 1`
an unknown key in the manifest, a parameter or a sample: fix the spelling or remove it
a value has the wrong JSON type (a number where text is expected): fix the value
the entry file does not exist: create it, or fix `entry`
`entry` is absolute or leaves the folder: name a file inside it
the folder's name is not a valid background name (letters, digits, `-`, `_`): rename the folder. The deck could never select it, so only `urdeck-cli` reports it
the shader does not compile: the compiler's message follows, with its line number
the shader declares a `uniform shader`: the host has nothing to give it; remove it
a uniform has a type that cannot be set (`int`, a matrix): it stays 0; use `float`
a `// default:` cannot be read: give numbers matching the type, or a `#RRGGBB` colour
the manifest annotates a parameter the shader does not declare: fix the name
the shader declares a parameter the manifest does not annotate: add it under `parameters`
the manifest annotates a name that belongs to the product (`speed`, `iTime`, ...): remove it
`kind` `color` on a parameter without three or four components: use `float3` or `float4`
an unknown `kind`: use `number` or `color`
`min` is above `max`, or the shader's default is outside the range: fix the range or the default
no `title`
no `description`
a parameter that is not `hidden` has no `description`
no `samples`: render a picture and list it
a sample file does not exist: create it or fix `file`
a sample `file` is absolute or leaves the folder: name a file inside it
an unknown sample `type`: use `image` (or `video`)
the shader says `layout(color)` and the manifest says `kind` `number`: the manifest wins

only `urdeck-cli shader render` reports it: the picture is still the theme's background colour everywhere, so the shader drew nothing at that time. Check `--time` and the alpha of the returned colour; a shader can be legitimately blank at one instant
`theme.json` is missing, is not valid JSON or holds no object: add it, or fix the syntax at the position given. Nothing else is checked
a key the deck does not read (a typo, or a key left over from an older draft): fix the name, the message suggests the nearest key
a value of the wrong JSON type (also logged): the deck skips that value and takes the default
a number outside its range, which the message gives (also logged): the deck uses the default
a value that is not one of the names allowed, which the message lists (also logged; the case does not matter)
a colour that is not `#RRGGBB` or `#AARRGGBB` (also logged)
a list outside its length limits or with an invalid element (also logged): the deck drops the list whole
a group that needs a member it does not have, such as a gradient without `colors` (also logged): the group is ignored

a font file is missing from the theme, is not a `.ttf`, `.otf` or `.ttc`, or its path leaves the theme's folder (also logged when it leaves the folder or cannot be loaded): add the file, fix the name, keep it inside the folder
a font file is over 3 MB (subset it) or has no licence file beside it (`*-OFL.txt`, `LICENSE*` or `*-LICENSE*`): add the licence so the theme can be shared
a font named by family, which is used only where it is installed: put a `.ttf` or `.otf` in the folder and name the file
a weight outside a variable font's range, or one a static font does not have, for a role (also logged): choose a weight the file has
`background.default.name` is not a background that exists: use a built-in one, or point `--background-dir` at yours
`meta.pairsWith.backgrounds` names a background that does not exist: fix the name or remove it
the default background is not in the theme's own `pairsWith` list: add it
the still background picture is missing, leaves the folder or is over 8 MB
`icons.set` names an icon set that exists neither in the theme's `icons/` folder nor among the built-in sets (also logged): fix the name
a border style, gradient or animation with `card.borderWidth` 0 (also logged): give the border a width
`card.borderAnimate` `spin` without a conic `card.borderGradient` (also logged): the deck switches the animation off
a pattern whose marks are closer than three pixels at the panel width (also logged): raise `spacing`
outside corner marks reaching past `card.gap`, thickness included (also logged): move them in or widen the gap
a shadow or glow whose reach is more than the gap over a translucent fill (logged as information, the deck limits it): reduce the blur or offset
a line (border, highlight, accent strip, corner mark) that resolves under one pixel, which the deck draws 1 px wide (also logged)
`card.compact.shape` `circle` on a card that is not square, which is a capsule (also logged)

`card.borderAnimate` on a `dashed` `card.borderStyle` (also logged): the border is drawn still, because the moving ring is stretched round the card and a dash pattern fitted to each side does not survive that

the text colour on the card fill, or on its gradient's darkest or lightest stop, is under 4.5:1: change the colours; a translucent fill is composited over `colors.background`, and the message says so because the page behind may be a moving background
the text colour on a card tint is under 4.5:1 (a tinted card keeps `colors.text`): change the tint at the position the message names
the muted text colour on the card fill is under 3:1
an icon set's `manifest.json` is missing, is not valid JSON, has a `version` other than 1 or has no `keys` (also logged): add or fix it
a manifest entry names a file that is missing, does not end in `.svg` or leaves the set's folder (also logged)
an icon file breaks the file rules: over 4 KB, no `viewBox` of `0 0 24 24`, an element or attribute that is not allowed, a `transform`, not valid XML (also logged)
a manifest key is not one of the product's icon keys, so no widget asks for it
the manifest's `license` or `source` is empty, or the set's folder has no licence file
an `.svg` file in the set's folder that no manifest entry names (the tool alone reports it)
the set has no icon for some of the product's keys; the message names them and says `outline` answers them
`meta` lacks a `name`, a `description` or a `mode`: add them so an editor can list the theme
more than one continuous animation is on (also logged): each costs CPU while it runs

themes.description: A technical drawing come alive. Cyanotype ground with a drafting grid, dashed outlines, yellow corner marks and dimension lines. Gauges are protractor dials with one needle.
themes.name: blueprint

themes.description: IT and business. Near-black, hairline cards with registration corners, mono numerals, segmented bars, one phosphor accent, with the status word turning amber and red under load.
themes.name: carbon

themes.description: The standard UrDeck look: deep navy cards with a blue accent.
themes.name: default-dark

themes.description: The standard UrDeck look on a light ground.
themes.name: default-light

themes.description: An instrument cluster. Chamfered cards, tachometer gauges with a red-line zone that lights when load spikes, condensed italic numerals glowing amber.
themes.name: ember

themes.description: Translucent cards over a deep blue-violet ground, made for a moving background.
themes.name: glass

themes.description: Executive calm. Warm black, champagne hairlines, high-contrast Didone numerals, gauges reduced to a thin ring with one jewel marker, circular dock buttons.
themes.name: obsidian

themes.description: The daylight option. Warm off-white, soft shadows instead of borders, one vermilion accent, tabular figures. Reads like a well-set report.
themes.name: paper

themes.description: The loud one. Flat saturated colour per card, thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, huge heavy numerals. Photographs well for the site.
themes.name: pop

themes.description: Glass, grown up. Thick frost, a specular top edge and inner rim light make cards read as cut glass. Light, wide numerals. The safe showpiece over any moving background.
themes.name: prism

themes.description: The RGB crowd. A slow spectrum travels round every card edge, numbers glow, gauges are gradient arcs whose hue follows load, tiles light a strip underneath like case fans.
themes.name: rigline
